definitions.gloss: a person who loves sweets; someone with a sweet tooth
definitions.explanation: a person who prefers sweet foods and desserts, especially as opposed to alcohol

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}は{甘党|あまとう}だからケーキが{大好|だいす}き。
examples.english: I have a sweet tooth, so I love cake.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{甘党|あまとう}で、お{酒|さけ}より{和菓子|わがし}が{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: My father has a sweet tooth and prefers Japanese sweets to alcohol.

examples.japanese: {甘党|あまとう}の{人|ひと}にぴったりの{新作|しんさく}スイーツが{発売|はつばい}された。
examples.english: A new dessert perfect for people with a sweet tooth has been released.

notes:
FORMATION:
{甘|あま}い (sweet) + {党|とう} (party, group) → sweet party/group

The {党|とう} suffix indicates belonging to a preference group.

CONTRAST WITH {辛党|からとう}:
Originally, {甘党|あまとう} vs {辛党|からとう} was about sweets vs alcohol (not spicy food):
- {甘党|あまとう}: prefers sweets, doesn't drink much
- {辛党|からとう}: prefers drinking alcohol

However, modern usage sometimes interprets {辛党|からとう} as someone who likes spicy food.

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {甘|あま}いもの{好|ず}き (lover of sweet things)
- スイーツ{好|ず}き (dessert lover)
- {甘|あま}い{物|もの}に{目|め}がない (can't resist sweets)
